description: The declared disposition of every artifact class this repository tracks. A hygiene gate that only matches suspicious shapes answers 'no bad shapes were found'; this policy answers the stronger question 'every artifact is the class it was meant to be', which is the only claim that survives encryption. scripts/repo-hygiene.sh enforces the encrypted-local class from .gitattributes. This file is a template artifact copied verbatim, with no substitution tokens.

classes.name: source
classes.intent: Human-authored, inspectable code and documentation tracked in git.
classes.declared_by: default: anything not matched by another class

classes.name: generated
classes.intent: Build output and caches reproducible from source.
classes.hygiene: forbidden-path rules reject it if staged

classes.name: encrypted-local
classes.intent: Sensitive data kept in-repo but encrypted at rest (addons/encrypted_local_areas).
classes.hygiene: reported covered-by-encryption; ciphertext at an undeclared path (encrypted-path-not-declared) or plaintext at a declared path (plaintext-at-encrypted-path) is a finding

classes.name: ignored-local
classes.intent: Local-only scratch, session output, and machine config that must never be committed.
classes.hygiene: forbidden-path rules reject it if staged

audit.convention: Record each classification pass as a dated, committed artifact (audits/local-artifact-classification-YYYY-MM-DD.json) so 'we looked' is checkable instead of remembered and the next audit is a diff.
